title: Adhaar
heading: Providing a Foundation for Every Child's Future
description: Quality education reaching last-mile children in villages and remote communities.
paragraphs: Our flagship educational project, Adhaar, focuses on non-formal pre-nursery and primary classes. We target children living in suburban slums and distant village communities who lack direct access to formal public schools.

Through Adhaar, children receive primary lessons, nutritional kits, uniforms, and stationary. Our curriculum is tailored to bridge the educational gap, preparing these last-mile children to integrate into formal state schools smoothly.
By organizing health camps and topper prize distributions, we create a thriving study environment that encourages parents to prioritize their children's education.

title: Vaidehi
heading: Enabling Self-Reliance and Confidence for Girls
description: Empowering women through livelihood training, confidence building, and rights awareness.
paragraphs: Vaidehi is focused on supporting adolescent girls and young women in rural and semi-urban communities. We address critical gaps in girls' health, safety, and occupational choices.

The program provides structured livelihood training—including tailoring, handicraft building, and computer literacy. Parallelly, we conduct awareness circles covering gender rights, basic legal knowledge, and menstrual sanitation.
With regular supplies of nutritional food and health counseling, Vaidehi enables young girls to emerge as confident leaders of their own families and local villages.

title: Yagna
heading: Restoring Ecological Balance to Our Habitats
description: Creating a clean, healthy environment for establishing a sustainable society.
paragraphs: Yagna is our dedicated program for environmental protection. We focus on soil health, local lake revitalization, clean-air trees, and climate adaptions for agriculture.

We run massive, volunteer-driven tree plantation programs, cleaning waste nodes and transforming them into mini forests. Water protection efforts help villagers harvest rainwater and conserve groundwater tables.
Our team educates local farm owners on organic manures, ensuring that nature and agriculture coexist to sustain rural economies.

title: Vaimalya
heading: Establishing Waste Segregation and Hygiene Solutions
description: Effective local waste disposal and environment management solutions for communities.
paragraphs: Vaimalya tackles waste disposal and sanitation. We set up color-coded dustbins, carry out street cleanings, and build community sanitation units.
We partner with local households and waste pickers to establish waste sorting protocols. Households are educated on composting biodegradable kitchen scraps to minimize landfill loads.
Our sanitation drives focus on making public streets litter-free, promoting community health, and reducing the threat of waterborne diseases.

title: Charcha
heading: Spreading Knowledge Through Seminars and Webinars
description: Knowledge sharing and community mobilization through structured seminars and interactive webinars.
paragraphs: Charcha represents our dialogue and knowledge dissemination pillar. We believe that lasting grassroots action requires informed dialogue, scientific backing, and policy advocacy.

We host regular community seminars, interactive townhalls, and webinars. Experts in climate science, child rights, and public health share research, breaking it down into simple community action guidelines.
By facilitating conversations between local developers, citizens, and policymakers, Charcha builds collaborative pathways for local environmental and social progress.

title: Litter Free India
heading: Making Garbage Disposal a National Citizen Habit
description: Community-led waste collection and litter consciousness campaigns across major areas.
paragraphs: Litter Free India is a citizens' movement. We focus on public transit hubs, community parks, and busy markets where solid litter is highest.
Through collaborative clean-ups, street plays, and partnerships (such as our drives with the Lucknow Airport Authority), we educate travelers on trash disposal habits.
Our volunteers install aesthetic trash bins, clear transit litter spots, and inspire citizens to pledge clean habits to protect our public spaces.
